title: Stone for the {place}
The masons are idle
summary: The masons of {settlement} have laid the last stone they had into the {place}. Bring {count} × {item} to {giver}.
{settlement} is short of stone for its {place}: {count} × {item} will do.
offer: The footings of the {place} are in, but we've no stone for the walls. {count} × {item}, and I'll pay you well over what the market gives.
Our quarry's flooded and the {place} stands half-built. Could you bring {count} × {item}?
progress: The mortar's drying in the tub. Stone, please!
complete: Good square stone. The {place} will outlast us all.
Thank you. The walls go up again tomorrow.
